title: Spot It Find The Difference
description: Get ready to put your observation skills to the test in Spot It: Find The Difference. This exciting puzzle game challenges you to spot the differences between two seemingly identical images! You’ll need sharp eyes and quick thinking to find all the hidden discrepancies! Earn gold and buy extra items or tips to help you navigate the various levels! Can you find all the differences before time runs out?
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play
